# CANDIDATE: RELAXED_ENTRY_BODY_GATE_BEAR_REVAL_0P10

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Relaxing the body percentage threshold from 0.20 to 0.10 for bear doji entries (side=='P') will allow more bearish entries to occur, specifically those with smaller real bodies (between 10% and 20% of the range). The original gate (threshold=0.20) removed a net-winner set of 44 bear doji entries (+$200 net). By relaxing the threshold, we expect to add back a portion of this set, potentially improving edge_capture on J winner days while avoiding increased losses on J loser days.

## Mechanism

The gate `ENTRY_BODY_GATE_BEAR_REVAL` (gates.py #13) blocks bearish entries when the entry bar's body percentage (|close-open|/(high-low)) is below `entry_bar_body_pct_min`. 
- Current threshold: 0.20 (blocks bars with body < 20% of range)  
- Proposed threshold: 0.10 (blocks bars with body < 10% of range)  
This change makes the gate less restrictive, allowing additional bearish entries with body percentages in [0.10, 0.20) that were previously blocked. Entry logic remains otherwise unchanged: side=='P' and all other context filters pass. Exit logic uses standard v15 rules (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, premium stop catastrophe cap).
